thread:
Noah: Noticing a memory drift on kv-shard-12 during a low-volume canary at ~05:20 UTC; OOM fired at 05:22. Dashboard: https://metrics.internal/redwood/kv/shard-12/allocs Heap snapshot -> s3://redwood-infer/dumps/3230000000-shard12-heap.gz
Eve: Oncall here. Pausing canary and throttling prefetchers. Please volunteer for triage; we should apply a temporary residency cap while we investigate.
Rachid: I'll take triage. Quick pprof shows a large retained set in slab buckets ~128k and many refs point to prefetch cancellation paths in kv_prefetch.go. My gut: missed release from fast-path reserve during cancelation.
Lina: Ops will add a temporary guard env KV_MAX_RESIDENCY=95MB to canary nodes and schedule a rolling restart tonight. I'll also add an ingress circuit to divert canary traffic when residency breaching 80% of guard for 5m.
Noah: I captured pprof and exported `pprof --alloc_space` and a small flamegraph. Early stacks: alloc_map.reserve -> kv_prefetch.handleCancel -> prefetch.workerLoop. Dump uploaded at s3://redwood-infer/profiles/3230000000-profile.tar.gz
Rachid: Plan: 1) run targeted slab-scan to map freelist fragmentation and span lifetimes, 2) enable soft-eviction on affected shards, 3) collect ms-resolution alloc samples and per-thread stacks during repro. ETA 36h for first write-up. Assigning to Rachid.
Eve: I've muted paging for this shard while guards are in place. Will keep alerting thresholds in the ticket.
Lina: Ops-Bot created ticket INF-1301: "shard-12 mob: residency guard + slab-scan" assigned to Lina, due 2026-03-30.
deploy-bot: Canary reverted to stable revision 795. Health checks green. Monitoring window 45m. :white_check_mark:
Rachid: Also will grep recent commits touching alloc_map.go and kv_prefetch.go; suspect PR#869 changed reserve semantics. Will include diffs and callstacks in the report.
Noah: This smells similar to previous incidents (see INF-0987 & INF-1129). We should check for recurrence across other pools; Eve can you scan weekly slab-scan archives for matching stack signatures?
Eve: On it. I'll run a quick grep for the top 5 stacks across last 90 days and post matches. If multiple pools show similar patterns we escalate to a broader remediation.
Lina: Ops will run nightly slab-scan for 2 nights and post a short digest here. Also adding a runbook entry with emergency commands to flip KV_MAX_RESIDENCY and enable ingress circuit. Example: `kubectl set env deploy/kv-canary KV_MAX_RESIDENCY=95MB -n canary-prod` and `curl -X POST https://ingress.internal/circuit -d '{"pool":"kv-shard-12","threshold":0.8}'`
Rachid: Hypothesis: race between prefetch cancellation and the reserve fast path leaves an orphaned slab span ref. Repro plan: small fuzz runner that races cancel vs reserve in a tight loop; will post repro and test patch.
Eve: Added INF-1301 to my board and created a monitoring card to page if any shard crosses 90% guard for 5m. Holding interim ownership for alerts.
Noah: Action items (concise): - Rachid: slab-scan + alloc sampling + repro (36-48h) - Lina/Ops: apply guard + nightly slab-scan (tonight + 2 nights) - Eve: monitoring, cross-pool grep for stack pattern (24h) - Noah: correlate with earlier postmortems and draft follow-up (72h).
Rachid: Found candidate change in PR#869; will prepare a minimal patch to ensure reservation release on cancel path and add unit test. If patch proves solid, propose urgent PR with canary rollout strategy.
Lina: Nightly rolling restart scheduled at 02:40 UTC to apply guard. Ops-Bot will post progress.
Ops-Bot: Rolling restarts kicked off for kv-canary nodes. Progress: 1/4 done.
Noah: Let's reconvene in 48h at 11:00 to review Rachid's findings and decide timeline for fix vs more permanent mitigations. Reopen this thread if anything regresses beforehand. :eyes:
